messages.text:
Any idea when this would ship? It's been almost 2 months and I don't see
this product one your order tracking page.

Hi there,

Happy to track this down for you. I just need the order number (it looks like Shop···· on your confirmation) and the email address on the order, and I'll pull up the exact ship date and tell you where it stands.

One thing that may already explain part of it: our shipment status page at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status only shows batches of the products we stock at our own warehouse. Anything that ships direct from the manufacturer never appears there, so a product missing from that page is not a sign that something is wrong with your order.

Send me those two details and I'll come straight back with the date and, if it has already left, the tracking.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
